title: Tele Medicine Platform — Overview
seo_title: Tele Medicine Platform — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.

blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of Tele Medicine Platform — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

Tele Medicine Platform unifies our security delivery: zero-trust enforcement points (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity), detection-as-code with ATT&CK coverage, cloud posture guardrails, and the AI-specific layer — prompt-injection defense, agent containment, shadow-AI discovery and model security cards.

blocks.title: Tele Medicine Platform — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: Signals, context and policy converge at the decision layer; every scored decision is logged with its inputs so it can be replayed at audit.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Tele Medicine Platform — Overview is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

Sentinel is engineered for the evidence economy: controls mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-207, DORA and AI regimes, tested continuously, exported to auditors. Boards get measured trust reduction, not adjectives.

items: Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
Spend per query attributed to the team that wrote it — the meter everyone can see.
Up 97–99.3% of tables inside their declared window per workflow, reported weekly against the signed baseline
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
Evidence generated as a by-product of doing the work — audit readiness stops being a season.
The pattern is used where it fits; where your estate differs, the difference is written down and owned.
Decision ownership named per metric — the org chart and the system agree on who answers.

blocks.x: Certified integration surface: SIEM/XDR, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA, IdPs/IGA, CNAPP tooling.
